name: Tongan sky
summary: The stars of Tongan seafarers: wild ducks, strings of fish and the names of islands in the sky. Some identifications are only conjecture.

001.name: The Southern Wild Duck
001.description: The Southern Cross. Not visible from Hungary.

002.name: The Two Men
002.description: The two bright stars of Gemini, Castor and Pollux.

003.name: The Wild Duck
003.description: The three stars of Orion’s Belt.

004.name: The Pigeon Perch
004.description: The V-shaped Hyades that form the head of Taurus, and Aldebaran: a branch on which pigeons perch.

005.name: The Great Wild Duck
005.description: The “False Cross” made of the stars of Carina and Vela. Not visible from Hungary.

006.name: The Hilltop
006.description: The two bright stars of Centaurus (Alpha and Beta Centauri). Not visible from Hungary.

007.name: The String of Fish
007.description: Orion’s Belt and Sword: fish threaded on a cord.

008.name: The Wild Duck’s Spit of Land
008.description: A long line from Orion’s Belt to the southern sky, joining the three wild duck figures (Toloa, Toloatonga, Toloalahi). Most of it is not visible from Hungary.

009.name: The Two Carriers
009.description: The stars of Coma Berenices. The identification is conjecture.

010.name: The Cloud of ʻUvea
010.description: The semicircle of Corona Borealis; ʻUvea (Wallis) is an island north of Tonga. The identification is conjecture.

011.name: The Wing of Tafahi
011.description: The W shape of Cassiopeia; Tafahi is a Tongan island. The identification is conjecture.
